tide-pool-help: Choose a change, predict with pictures, then try it. Nothing is lost if the result surprises you. With a grown-up, take turns choosing changes and compare both predictions. In real life, different species respond differently, and changes take much longer.
float-sink-help: Predict float or sink, drop the object, then sort it onto the matching shelf. A surprise is a discovery. Build a clay or foil boat and add pebbles until it sinks. In take turns mode, compare how many each boat held. In real life, materials, sizes, trapped air and boat balance change the result. Our tank uses example objects and equal pebbles.
crab-commands-help: Tap cards to make a program, then press Go. Tap a card in the strip to remove it. If the crab bumps, change that card and try again. Gentle uses compass arrows. Growing uses forward and turns. Challenge adds Repeat: do the previous card two more times. Together, alternate placing cards. Hint shows a shortest program. No move limit and no timer.
